Privacy Policy

How National Global Academy handles information shared through this website.

  1. Home
  2. Privacy Policy

Last updated: 10 November 2026

[CONFIRM: Have the academy’s legal/privacy owner review this template, insert verified contact details and align it with the actual CRM, analytics and data-retention practices before launch.]

1. Who we are

This website is operated for National Global Academy (“NGA”, “we”, “us”), a career-training academy in India. For privacy questions, contact [CONFIRM: admissions email] or write to [CONFIRM: Full academy address, city, state and PIN code].

2. Information we collect

When you submit an enquiry, eligibility form or brochure request, we may collect your name, phone/WhatsApp number, email address, qualification, pathway interest and message. If you apply, separate admission processes may require academic, identity, medical or other documents; those should be requested only through verified channels.

We may also receive basic technical information such as device type, pages visited, approximate region and referral source through server logs or analytics when enabled.

3. How we use information

  • To respond to enquiries and provide requested course, fee and admission information.
  • To arrange counselling, communicate about January Batch / July Batch admissions and maintain enquiry records.
  • To provide downloadable resources and requested follow-up.
  • To improve website content, accessibility, security and performance.
  • To comply with applicable law, prevent fraud and protect our systems.

4. Calls, email and WhatsApp

By submitting a form, you ask us to contact you about your enquiry using the details supplied. WhatsApp communication is also governed by WhatsApp/Meta’s terms and privacy practices. Do not send OTPs, passwords or unnecessary sensitive records through chat.

5. Sharing and service providers

We may use service providers for website hosting, form delivery, customer relationship management, email, analytics or communications. They process information for their respective functions. We do not present enquiry data as something to sell. [CONFIRM: List actual processors and any cross-border storage.]

6. Cookies and analytics

The base site does not require advertising cookies. If Google Analytics 4 is enabled, Google may set or read analytics identifiers subject to its policies and your browser settings. [CONFIRM: Add a consent mechanism if required by the final analytics/marketing setup and applicable law.]

7. Retention and security

We retain information only as long as reasonably needed for enquiries, admissions, legal obligations and dispute handling. [CONFIRM: Insert actual retention periods.] Reasonable safeguards should be used, but no online transmission or storage system can be guaranteed completely secure.

8. Your choices and rights

You may ask to access, correct or delete information you provided, or withdraw consent for follow-up, subject to applicable law and necessary record retention. Contact us using the details above. You can also ask us to stop promotional messages without preventing responses to an active request.

9. Children and guardians

Our audience includes students under 18. If you are a minor, involve a parent or guardian before sharing personal information or making an admission decision. Parents may contact us about information submitted by their child.

10. Third-party links

This site links to WhatsApp, stock media providers and potentially maps, social platforms and official resources. Their privacy practices are separate from ours.

11. Changes to this policy

We may update this page as services or legal requirements change. The latest version will carry a revised date.
